posts.author: mike_312
posts.body:
Hi everyone.
I'm using the SkillsStateCore plugin from visustella for rpg maker mz, and I'm unable to make a passive skill of some kind. I'd like to set a condition that the passive skill is activated when the user has, for example, 20% health. I know it can be done but I'm unable to figure out how, even after reading the manual. Can anyone help me?

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
A link:
Skills and States Core VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
I would guess something like this:
<JS Passive Condition>
condition = user.hpRate() <= 0.2;  // true iff HP is at 20% or less
</JS Passive Condition>
Avoid putting any traits affecting max HP on this passive state, otherwise that could trigger an infinite loop...or, more likely, VisuStella's safety checks.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
mike_312 said:
The only thing is that I'm having trouble putting it in reverse. That is, setting the condition to be, for example, having 80% health or more activates the state.
Click to expand...
You can swap the
<=
(less than or equal) for a
>=
(greater than or equal), i.e.
<JS Passive Condition>
condition = user.hpRate() >= 0.8;  // true iff HP is at 80% or more
</JS Passive Condition>
